currentParagraphText: “Have you talked to them about it?” Jake questioned with a frown.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Have you talked to them about it?” Jake questioned with a frown.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yeah, I have,” Caleb nodded. “Mom and Dad... they aren’t cut out for this world the two of us live in. Not really. I tried to bring up the topic several times and in several different ways, but at this point, I’ve just accepted it. They aren’t fighters, and I don’t think we can make them fighters either. Even if we somehow could, would we really want to turn them into something they never wanted to be in the first place?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Caleb got quiet as he also stared out at the city before sighing. “A lot more than you have, I reckon... and I know where you’re going with this.”
